integrity: Finite certificate and checker embedded; output replayed. Mathematical forest and counting arguments included; historical sources are identified and qualified.
scientific_limitations: The exact online result is restricted to one through six labels. Asymptotic mistake lower bounds for total-order comparison learning and the counting upper bound predate this work. Historical priority for exact small-case decision trees is not fully established; no independent validation. Source date corresponds to the 2021 mathematical-logic Littlestone/VC-dimension research context, not to the earlier supporting comparison-learning literature.
title: Sharp information-bound online shattering for pairwise comparisons of up to six labels
